name: Teen Volunteer Application at Banner Desert Medical Center
org: Banner Desert Medical Center and Banner Children's at Desert
what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital area. You might work at the info desk, family lobby, gift shop, food service or nursing units.
who_can_apply: Teens can use the Teen Application. The page does not state the age range. Call to ask.
deadline_text: Summer Student Application is accepted only January to March. No other deadline stated.
how_to_apply: Apply and interview. Then a health screen and background check. Then orientation. Use the Teen Application or Summer Student Application on the page, or call (480) 412-3258.
notes: Teen age range is not stated on the page. Banner Desert Medical Center is in Mesa.
